question: How many open claims does each California adjuster have?

report.interpretation: Open claims (status = 'open' on the 2026-09-30 extract date) for each adjuster in the California region. All California adjusters are included. I counted all open claims assigned to each adjuster, regardless of report date. All 79 open claims held by these adjusters are California claims.
report.answer: The 7 California adjusters hold 79 open claims in total. Mariah Berger has the most with 13. Victoria Hampton and Timothy Castro have 12 each. Becky Crane and Alyssa Patel have 11 each. Emma Moss and Cody Adkins have 10 each. The workload is fairly even. No California adjuster has left the company.
